column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-30 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the 37 variant names and 45 mutant names the run actually read, as one pool
#   checks    the check ids tools/execution_accelerator_gate.py implements
# The 82 cases and mutants are partitioned across this phase's claim surfaces so each item
# is claimed exactly once. That is what makes the join evidence rather than decoration:
# an item nobody claims, or one claimed twice, fails the gate.
# The five formerly empty contract surfaces now each name a direct one-axis negative and
# legal twin. The five-calculus surface names the four independently authored projection
# metrics. Live-only surfaces remain empty because this Register-1 phase cannot observe them.
